title: Dónde colocar el adverbio
communication_goal: Colocar correctamente los adverbios de frecuencia con verbos principales y con el verbo to be.
situation: Describes rutinas de personas, horarios y estados habituales con frases naturales.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.english: Yes, she is. She is always on time.

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.english: He usually arrives at eight, but he is sometimes late.
dialogue.spanish: Normalmente llega a las ocho, pero a veces llega tarde.

explanation_es: Con un verbo principal, el adverbio suele ir antes del verbo: She often checks email. Con to be, va después de am/is/are: She is often tired; We are always on time. Sometimes también puede ir al inicio: Sometimes I feel tired.
spanish_speaker_notes: No digas She checks often email; coloca often antes del verbo principal.
Con be, no pongas el adverbio antes de be: She often is tired suena menos natural en este nivel; usa She is often tired.
La posición depende del verbo, no solo de la traducción.
Always y never también pueden aparecer con be: I am always ready; He is never late.

targets.focus: usually y la s de arrives

pronunciation.tip_es: Haz una pausa visual entre sujeto, adverbio y verbo al practicar, pero luego une la frase al hablar.

reading.title: A reliable team
reading.text: Ana is always on time. She usually checks her email before work. Carlos usually arrives at eight, but he is sometimes late. The manager is never angry because Carlos always calls when he is late.
